registers.name: GICR_VSGIPENDR
registers.fullName: Redistributor virtual SGI pending state register
registers.description: Redistributor virtual SGI pending state register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: Busy
fields.description: ID of target vPEID [0b0=Query of virtual SGI state not in progress. ; 0b1=Query of virtual SGI state in progress.]

fields.name: Pending
fields.description: Pending state of virtual SGIs for requested vPEID. This 字段 is UNKNOWN when GICR_VSGIPENDR.Busy == 1
